evidence_summary.labels: Multi-case visual audit agrees with the BraTS post-treatment convention used by the UCSD-PTGBM dataset: label 1 is non-enhancing tumor core, label 2 is surrounding non-enhancing FLAIR hyperintensity, label 3 is enhancing tissue, and label 4 is resection cavity.
evidence_summary.channels: Channel contrast behavior across representative cases is consistent with: T1, T1ce, T2, FLAIR, RSI cellularity, ADC. In particular, channel 1 shows contrast enhancement; channel 2 has T2-like bright CSF; channel 3 suppresses CSF with FLAIR hyperintensity; channel 5 has ADC-like free-water hyperintensity; channel 4 shows the complementary RSI cellularity behavior.

provenance_note: Locked after multi-case visual audit of the 184-file preprocessed dataset and cross-check against the published UCSD-PTGBM description and the BraTS post-treatment label convention. Preserve this file with the analysis outputs.
